content: MK notes that Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's father Afẓal al-Dīn and brother Ṣadr al-Dīn both attended the majlises of Fażl Allāh himself during the early career of the latter as a Sufi and dream interpreter in Isfahan; MK's footnote says this is known from Hurufi sources, which report the two Turkas seeking him out to have their dreams interpreted.
refers_to_primary: Hurufi sources (Nāfajī, Khwābnāma; Sayyid Isḥāq, Khwābnāma), via MK fn 41
